posts.title: Termux部署Samba服务
posts.text: 1, 安装Samba$ pkg i samba 2, 创建用户需要用到root权限，可以装个PRoot来模拟root环境安装PRoot$ pkg i proot运行PRoot$ proot -0创建用户（自行修改用户名）# smbpasswd -a 用户名推出PRoot# exit 3, 复制预设的配置文件模板到对应路径1234$ mkdir $PREFIX/etc/samba$ cp \ $PREFIX/share/doc/samba/smb.conf.example \ $PREFIX/etc/smb.conf 4, 修改配置文件Termux带的这个配置文件模板就挺完善的了，按需稍作修改就行123456789[Internal storage] comment = Internal storage path = /sdcard/ vfs objects = aio_pthread aio_pthread:aio open = yes read only = no browseable = yes writable = yes guest ok = no 可以按需另加，例123456789[Pic] comment = Pictures path = /sdcard/Pictures/ vfs objects = aio_pthread aio_pthread:aio open = yes read only = no browseable = yes writable = yes guest ok = no 5, 尝试启动Samba服务$ smbd -i -d3 6, 尝试连接 7, 创建Termux Service每次都手动运行命令太麻烦，这里直接创建服务，参考Termux-services - Termux Wiki`$ pkg i termux-services$ mkdir -p $PREFIX/var/service/smbd/log$ ln -sf \ $PREFIX/share/termux-services/svlogger \ $PREFIX/var/service/smbd/log/run$ cat > $PREFIX/var/service/smbd/run << EOF #!/data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/shsmbd -F -d3EOF$ chmod +x $PREFIX/var/service/smbd/run$ sv enable smbd$ sv up smbd
